text: 其中，周一至周五分别到期9255亿元、3055亿元、2065亿元、2705亿元、1340亿元。此外，周三还将有3000亿元3个月期买断式逆回购到期。中国央行此前公布，周一将开展3000亿元隔夜逆回购操作。
text_en: Among them, Monday to Friday maturities are 925.5B, 305.5B, 206.5B, 270.5B, and 134B yuan respectively. Additionally, 300B yuan of 3-month outright reverse repos mature Wednesday. PBOC previously announced 300B yuan overnight reverse repo operation Monday.
